verdict.rationale: Postman documents a programmatic Postman API (and an OpenAPI file is served), but nothing in the evidence shows that API is versioned or covered by a published deprecation policy. The mention of workspaces where teams can "version" their work is about versioning users' own API projects, not the stability of Postman's own API, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
